body:
Founder screenshot: new Materials panel covered the whole screen, had to delete it via element inspector to see the editor. Root cause: .layout is a fixed 2-column CSS grid (sidebar + main); MaterialsPanel was rendered as a 3rd top-level grid child (its own <aside>), which grid auto-placement wrapped onto a full-width new row covering everything below. Fixed by nesting it inside the existing sidebar aside instead of as a grid sibling. Commit 6f2b32e.

⚓ ☃
title: Fix MaterialsPanel covering the SHANKPIT editor
